title: The original URL for this prediction will no longer be available in 11 years (2011)
summary: A long-term prediction record from Longbets.org made in 2011, where someone bet that a specific URL would no longer be available in 11 years. This represents an interesting experiment in tracking long-term internet predictions and their outcomes over time.
problem_solved: Documents and tracks long-term predictions about internet sustainability and URL longevity
why_valuable: Provides empirical data about how URLs and web content survive or disappear over decade-long timeframes, useful for understanding digital preservation challenges
